en: to be fun / to be interesting

examples.en: Korean dramas are really entertaining.
That friend is really funny.
This game is really fun!
How is the Korean class? — It's really fun.
I play board games with my friends. It's a lot of fun.

explain: 재미있다는 “fun”과 “interesting” 두 뜻이 다 있어요. 영화, 게임, 사람, 이야기에 모두 써요. 말할 때는 “재밌어요”로 줄여서 많이 말해요.

phrases.en: to get into something; to start enjoying it
phrases.nuance_ko: 처음엔 별로였지만 하다 보니 좋아질 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: used when something wasn't fun at first but became enjoyable as you kept doing it
phrases.en_equiv: to get into something; to start enjoying it
